name: unity-runtime-invocation-table
target: Unity 2021 LTS – 6.x; runtime + editor C# scripting
status: Fable-reviewed v1 scope. Consumed lists are grounded in the local Unity 6.5 corpus and FABLE-SCOPE-DECISIONS.md; pending rows are explicitly marked or quarantined. Runtime consumption must stay inside the consumed sections.

consumed.note: Sections here are read by unity.ts at runtime; the fields consumed are named per section. Everything under catalogNotes is documentation-only provenance. This mirrors blender-invocation-table.json's consumed/catalogNotes split.
consumed.detection: project-level sufficient markers plus source evidence rules used by detect() to recognize a Unity project
consumed.hostInvokedBases: key set (the host-invoked-base whitelist); <base>.hostInvokedMethods (engine/editor calls these by reflection, so they look dead)
consumed.serializationAttributes: attribute set → field kept live + its declared type emits a references edge
consumed.attributeEntryPoints: attribute → the decorated method/class is a host-invoked entry point (kept live); menu/path string captured where present
consumed.typeReferenceAttributes: attribute → typeof(X)/type argument emits a references edge to X
consumed.stringInvokedCallSites: callsite API → its string-literal method-name argument links to a sibling method (references)

detection.note: detect() returns true when the C# project is a Unity project. Project/file-layout markers are sufficient; source fallback requires concrete Unity base/attribute evidence. Bare using UnityEngine/UnityEditor is supporting context only and is not independently sufficient.
markers: a file named ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt exists in the project
a .cs file contains a concrete Unity host base or v1 Unity attribute in source
`using UnityEngine;` or `using UnityEditor;` may support detection only when paired with concrete source evidence

hostInvokedBases.note: A class is host-invoked only when its class-statement base is structurally one of these. Magic method names on non-host classes emit nothing. Method sets are closed, docs-grounded v1 sets; no convention or substring matching.

MonoBehaviour.detection: base list includes UnityEngine.MonoBehaviour; same-file base chains are allowed when proven in-file; cross-file base chains emit nothing

DecoratorDrawer.note: CreatePropertyGUI validated: listed on the DecoratorDrawer page in the local Unity 6.5 corpus.

AssetPostprocessor.note: Closed docs-grounded set; no OnPostprocess<Type> convention matching in v1.

AssetModificationProcessor.note: Hooks are static editor callbacks; non-static declarations emit nothing.

serializationAttributes.note: A field bearing one of these is set by the engine/inspector via serialization: keep it live and emit a references edge to its declared type when the type is a plain local/custom non-builtin name.
resolverNotes: [field: SerializeField] on an auto-property emits a liveness node referencing the PROPERTY symbol; never fabricate a backing-field node; emit nothing if the property symbol is unavailable.
Public fields of a [Serializable]/MonoBehaviour/ScriptableObject type are also serialized with no attribute, but detecting that requires Unity serializability rules and owner context; deferred.
Skip primitive, builtin, System.*, UnityEngine.*-qualified, and known external field types.

attributeEntryPoints.note: The decorated method or class is invoked by Unity/editor infrastructure, not by an in-code caller. Attribute matching accepts short and Attribute-suffixed forms with optional UnityEngine./UnityEditor. qualification; exact token only, no substring matches.

methodAttributes.note: typeof(X) ref only when an explicit typeof argument names a local/custom type; no first-parameter type inference in v1.

classAttributes.invokedBy: editor load runs the static constructor; keep the static ctor live

attributeEntryPoints.referenceKind: entry-point liveness (no target); pathArg strings captured for provenance, not link resolution in v1

typeReferenceAttributes.note: The attribute's typeof(X) argument emits a references edge to X. Skip primitive, builtin, System.*, UnityEngine.*-qualified, and known external types. DrawGizmo is a method entry point with optional typeof reference and lives under attributeEntryPoints.

stringInvokedCallSites.note: Preconditions for every call-site rule: (1) containing class provably host-based in the SAME file (direct or same-file-chained Unity host base); (2) single string LITERAL or bare-identifier nameof(M) — dotted nameof, concatenation, interpolation, variables, empty strings emit nothing; (3) exactly ONE same-class method matches — overload ambiguity emits NOTHING.

callSites.argument: first string literal or bare nameof(M)
callSites.linksTo: unique same-class sibling method only when receiver is implicit, this, or gameObject; any other receiver emits nothing; never project-wide name linking

callSites.argument: first string literal or bare nameof(M)
callSites.linksTo: unique same-class sibling method; receiver must be implicit or this
unique same-class coroutine method; receiver must be implicit or this
callSites.note: StartCoroutine(M()) is a normal static call; do not special-case it here.

callSites.argument: second string literal or bare nameof(M)
callSites.linksTo: unique same-class method on the declaring host-based class

catalogNotes.note: Not read by unity.ts at runtime. Provenance, quarantine, deferrals, and false-positive guard record for behaviors hardcoded in the resolver.

baseWhitelist.description: The host-invoked-base whitelist. A UnityEngine/UnityEditor base not in this set does not make its methods host-invoked. Runtime equivalent: Object.keys(hostInvokedBases).

falsePositiveGuards.rule: A method named Update/Start/OnEnable/etc. on a class whose base is not in the whitelist is a normal method; emit no host-invoked liveness. Bases are read only from class headers.
Same-file base chains may emit when proven in-file; cross-file base chains emit nothing under the per-file extraction ceiling.
Static-only attributes on non-static methods emit nothing; ContextMenu on static methods emits nothing.
String-invoked method references require exactly one same-class method match; overload ambiguity emits nothing.
SendMessage/BroadcastMessage/SendMessageUpwards link only for implicit, this, or gameObject receivers and only to a unique same-class sibling; never project-wide name linking.
Variables, concatenation, interpolation, dotted nameof, and empty strings emit nothing.
typeof(X) and serialized field types skip primitive, builtin, System.*, UnityEngine.*-qualified, and known external types.
Match attributes by exact token with optional Attribute suffix and UnityEngine./UnityEditor. qualification; no substring matches such as MenuItemCustom.

dynamicOrOutOfScope.resolverBehavior: Emit nothing in v1 unless separately proven.
Generic type args are ordinary static type references handled by C# extraction; do not double-emit.

monoBehaviourRectTransformPair.result: Local corpus has MonoBehaviour.OnChildRectTransformDimensionsChange page/xref and Messages row; no page, xref, or search hit for MonoBehaviour.OnRectTransformDimensionsChange.

tier2Deferred.description: Unity-only asset wiring; not in v1. Requires parsing non-code YAML assets and/or the future Unity Slice Pack static scanner.
items: UnityEvent inspector wiring: scene/.prefab/.asset YAML m_PersistentCalls to method.
Animation events: .anim asset functionName to method by name.
MonoBehaviour script usage: scene/prefab m_Script GUID to script asset.
Editor callback-registration APIs such as EditorApplication.update += fn.

resolverCoverageNotes: v1 Tier 1 is code-only: base+magic-method liveness, serialization-attribute field/property liveness plus type refs, attribute entry-point liveness, typeof type refs, and conservative string-invoked sibling-method links.
Cross-file base chains, computed strings, reflection, package-specific attributes, and all Tier 2 asset wiring emit nothing.
Pending-corpus-verification rows must be verified or quarantined before unity.ts consumes them.
